product_concept: A focused guide / checklist that helps independent personal trainers & online coaches manage programming, check-ins and progress without paying for bloated software.
core_problem: All-in-one coaching SaaS is expensive/overkill; spreadsheets get chaotic past ~15 clients.
desired_outcome: Manage programming, check-ins and progress without paying for bloated software.
core_transformation: From: All-in-one coaching SaaS is expensive/overkill; spreadsheets get chaotic past ~15 clients.  →  To: Manage programming, check-ins and progress without paying for bloated software.
product_promise: Get to 'Manage programming, check-ins and progress without paying for bloated software.' without the usual guesswork.
why_this_format: Chosen from executed-research evidence. Spreadsheet templates offer a one-time cost structure that eliminates monthly per-client software overhead while enabling reusable workout programming.
product_structure: structured tracker with fields + summary view
exclude: Anything freely available and already good enough
differentiation: Lack of cost-effective, non-subscription program management tools for trainers scaling past ~15 clients who refuse high SaaS fees.
price_range: $1.99 - $19.99 one-time (digital spreadsheet template), $10 - $25/month (entry SaaS allowance), $77 - $135/month (30-50 client SaaS tier)
key_objections: Templates never fit my exact case
evidence_summary: 2 observed + 1 inferred/other claims support a recurring problem for independent personal trainers & online coaches. Gap: 'better than a spreadsheet, cheaper than SaaS' one-time template; for app-switching-fatigued coaches.  [Executed research: 8 pages retrieved, 85 sources; critical unresolved: 0.]
risks_unknowns: Is the problem recurring and painful enough to pay to solve?: PARTIAL
